description: This file contains the implementation of Drupal hooks related to the image module, including help text, file download access control, file move and delete hooks, and entity pre-save/update/delete hooks for managing default images and image styles.

classes.name: ImageHooks
classes.description: A class implementing Drupal hooks for managing image-related functionalities such as help text, file access, and entity updates.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information for the image module, including descriptions of image styles, configuration, and usage.

methods.name: fileDownload
methods.description: Controls access to image files, especially derivatives in styles directory and sample images.

methods.name: fileMove
methods.description: Handles cleanup of image derivatives when files are moved.

methods.name: filePredelete
methods.description: Deletes image derivatives before a file entity is deleted.

methods.name: entityPresave
methods.description: Transforms default image data from array to single value before saving.

methods.name: fieldStorageConfigUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to image field storage configurations, including setting files as permanent and moving files if needed.

methods.name: fieldConfigUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to image field instances, including managing default images and file usage.

methods.name: fieldStorageConfigDelete
methods.description: Cleans up file usage when an image field storage configuration is deleted.

methods.name: fieldConfigDelete
methods.description: Cleans up file usage when an image field instance is deleted.
